verdict.rationale: Opting out of vendor telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for an observability SaaS with SDKs and a CLI, so the axis applies. The pack documents no setting, environment variable or flag to disable Braintrust's own product or SDK telemetry. The self-hosting option controls where customer trace data is stored, which is a different capability from opting out of usage tracking, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
